correctness.rationale: For a first ignition on one shore, every vertex on the opposite shore is forced immediately. Exactly one second ignition can preempt one vertex before the correlation-forcing wave; this contributes the indicator correction for an available opposite-sign correlation. Every other first-shore vertex is then governed by its sign-row inner product, while zero correlations are ties. All tied vertices lie on one independent shore and can thereafter be ignited independently. Maximizing over first vertices gives the displayed formula. Exhaustive direct search over 1168 signings and 651 additional structured profiles agrees.
